description: What kind of XRPL address is this, and what does a payment to it need? When to use: Before paying or listing an XRPL address: to learn whether it exists, whether it is a pseudo-account that rejects payments, and whether a payment needs a destination tag or deposit preauthorization. Prefer another tool: To check one payment end to end with amounts, trust lines and reserves (use `/v1/xrpl/payment-readiness`), or to read balances (use `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/summary`). Example: xrpl_address_kind {"address":"rhWTXC2m2gGGA9WozUaoMm6kLAVPb1tcS3"}

address.description: Valid classic XRPL account address (r..., checksum verified)

name: xrpl_address_kind

age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from the ledger

ledger_index.description: Validated ledger the data comes from

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

blackholed.description: True when the master key is disabled, there is no signer list and the regular key is absent or a known blackhole address; null when the account does not exist

anyOf.description: AccountRoot flags of the account decoded to booleans

disallow_incoming.description: Incoming checks, NFToken offers, payment channels and trust lines the account blocks

flags.description: AccountRoot flags decoded to booleans; null when the account does not exist

kind.description: not_found (no account), amm, vault or loan_broker (the pseudo-account of an AMM pool, a vault or a loan broker), or account

title: XRPL address kind
